findings: CMFD pipeline detects same-image copied regions. It is not an exact whole-file duplicate benchmark; self-neighbor suppression does not transfer to coordinates of separate files.
Keypoint extraction can miss low-structure copied regions; block methods trade dense coverage for much greater feature count. Missing descriptors cannot establish negative duplicate evidence.

Experiment sets minimum displacement50pixels and explicitly cannot detect smaller moves; keypoint output has1000pixel area threshold. These constraints exclude cases and must not be imported as universal duplicate filters.

Dataset described as48source scenes and87manual snippets; partially transparent boundary pixels excluded from pixel evaluation and occluded source/target regions adjusted. Copy provenance masks differ from direct pixel equality.
Feature thresholds manually fitted to benchmark; paper uses approximately4700generatedvariants, but this does not establish content-disjoint heldout calibration for our task.

Image-level and pixel-level precision/recall differ substantially; detecting a modified image does not prove all copied pixels or all candidate identities recovered. No winning algorithm accepted before remaining results are read.
